content.comment_body: Hello everyone. I am using a [product_name] module in a film inspection rewinding machine, where it controls three inverters through Modbus. Functionality is good overall. However, when changing the rewind direction, the [product_name] updates parameters relating to direction in two of the inverters. It appears that the [product_name] repeatedly sends commands regardless of whether the direction is changing or not. I am concerned that continuously overwriting inverter parameters may not be optimal. Is it possible to make Modbus communication occur only when necessary, by opening or closing the channel and sending commands selectively?
No, this isn’t possible. You can only configure a fixed interval for data communication in the connection table.

analysis.insight_summary: User is controlling inverters via Modbus in a film inspection rewinding machine with a [product_name] module. The module sends repeated commands to the inverters, which raises concerns about unnecessary parameter changes. Another user clarifies that only a fixed update interval is supported, and on-demand opening/closing of the Modbus channel is not possible.
analysis.user_expectations: User would like to manage Modbus communication so that commands are sent only when required, rather than using a fixed communication interval.
